board: STM32F407VG / MB997B, SYSCLK 168 MHz, Windows 10, CN1 powered and CN5 via original hub

firmware.noise_profile: On-device pre-gain PCM calibration: 504 ms warmup + 4 s averaging; fixed until recalibration

checks.tools/check.ps1: passed, 20 Rust tests plus build/fmt/firmware and host clippy
checks.compatibility_clippy: passed: no features, pdm-capture only, live-mic without suppression

host_parity.scope: Host execution of exact no_std f32 DSP with the same fixed profile; startup on-device calibration is separate.

analysis.limits: Room audio is uncontrolled. These metrics do not establish frequency response, calibrated gain, or absence of every USB packet loss.
Room audio is uncontrolled. These metrics do not establish frequency response, calibrated gain, or absence of every USB packet loss.

rtt.scope: Only visible firmware counters. Normal alt=0 cancels one pending packet; discarded_samples includes this. No proof of absence of every on-wire loss.

dwt_work.selection: stats stream=true and audio_permille >50 to omit partial start/stop intervals
dwt_work.scope: Instrumented DSP and packet preparation only, not complete CPU utilization. DSP deducts nested audio preparation cycles. Noise is a subset of DSP. Other IRQ time can be included within measured spans; other tasks/IRQs are not comprehensively covered.

intermediate_versions.label: Initial FFT, Flash acceleration disabled, integer queue
intermediate_versions.note: Instrumented work about 88%; no reported firmware error counters. Zero samples alone do not prove USB packet loss.

intermediate_versions.label: Flash acceleration enabled, integer queue
intermediate_versions.note: Long zero runs often not aligned to USB packet boundaries; final revision retains fractional PCM until final gain.

limitations: The 120 s final run has RTT counters; the standalone 60 s run has WAV completion and signal metrics without reading live MCU counters.
Zero counters and WAV metrics cannot prove absence of every USB on-wire loss.
No clean acoustic reference or calibrated on-device noise-reduction dB measurement was made; offline listening acceptance remains separate.
Physical USER long-press controls, mute, power-cycle calibration, repeated unplug/reconnect, Windows 11 and longer endurance remain unverified.
Stack high-water, strict WCET and complete end-to-end latency remain unmeasured.
final_state: Final default suppression firmware left running; debugger exited, no reset after successful calibration; uncommitted source changes.
local_evidence: Complete WAV/RTT/ELF/BIN and analysis files remain under ignored captures/; tracked summaries do not contain original speech audio.
